description: Load ONE company skill: its full text, which you follow verbatim, with its id, name, category, one-line description, revision and last change. Call it before you start a task a company skill covers (find it with anyforge_list_skills, whose descriptions say when each skill applies), and again in a later session rather than relying on an old copy, since the library is the current version. Pass skillId (from anyforge_list_skills) or the skill's exact name, ignoring case; not both. Errors to handle: skill_not_found (no skill has that id or name: list the library and pick one), ambiguous_skill_name (more than one skill has that name: call again with one of the skillIds it lists). Reads the company library only, not skill sources. Requires `read` scope; a Viewer's key may read.

name.description: The skill's exact name, ignoring case, e.g. "Release checklist".

skillId.description: The skill id, from anyforge_list_skills. Use it when you have it.

name: anyforge_get_skill
title: Get skill
